facts.text: Russia resumed strikes on **Kherson** after a local ceasefire in **Oleshky**, brokered by US First Lady **Melania Trump**, ended.

facts.text: The US approved the sale of **500 Patriot** air-defence missiles to Ukraine (President **Volodymyr Zelenskyy**).
